header.title: How to Replace a Refrigerator Thermostat
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to replace a malfunctioning refrigerator thermostat. Follow these instructions to safely remove the old thermostat and install a new one, restoring proper cooling function to your refrigerator.

steps.description: Before replacing the thermostat, ensure the appliance is disconnected from the power source for safety.
actions: Turn off the appliance from the mains
Locate the plug
Turn off the circuit breaker (if plug is hidden)

steps.description: This step instructs the user to locate the thermostat within the refrigerator or freezer.
actions: Find the thermostat
Determine the thermostat's position inside the refrigerator
Check the back of the fridge if it has a freezer on top
Check the roof of the fridge underneath the freezer panel if it has a freezer on top
Check the back of the freezer if the refrigerator is next to the freezer

steps.description: Remove all frozen food and shelves from the workspace, potentially requiring loosening screws and removing clips.
actions: Take out frozen food
Take out shelves
Loosen screws
Take out clips

steps.description: Gently detach wires connected to the thermostat using pliers, being careful not to break them.
actions: Pull wires away gently
Use pliers
Be careful not to pull too hard
Avoid gripping the wires in the middle

steps.description: Remove the old faulty thermostat from the refrigerator, being careful if it's near an evaporator tube.
actions: Remove any remaining screws or clips
Take out the old faulty thermostat

steps.description: Install the new thermostat into the refrigerator, reconnecting wires and securing the panel and shelving.
actions: Install the new replacement thermostat into the refrigerator
Place the thermostat in the same location as the old one
Screw the thermostat into place
Reconnect all the wires
Put the panel back over the thermostat securely
Put back any shelving

steps.description: Turn the refrigerator's power back on and monitor its temperature to ensure the new thermostat is functioning correctly.
actions: Turn the power to the refrigerator back on
Wait for the refrigerator to cool down
Monitor the refrigerator temperature
Verify the thermostat maintains a steady temperature
